desc.en: Hosted search solution with typo-tolerance, relevance, and UI libraries to easily create search experiences. The free "Build" plan includes 1M documents and 10K searches/month. Also offers [developer documentation search](https://docsearch.algolia.com/) for free.
desc.zh: 托管式搜索解决方案，提供容错、相关性和 UI 库，轻松打造搜索体验。免费的 “Build” 套餐包含 1M 个文档和每月 10K 次搜索。还免费提供[开发者文档搜索](https://docsearch.algolia.com/)。

desc.en: Free 1 GB memory and 1 GB storage
desc.zh: 免费 1 GB 内存和 1 GB 存储
